for: viewpoints/manifests/rainier.paradise-mountain.json: the lead's call; nothing here is applied

landmarks_append.where: after the summit, which stays landmarks[0]: eval's backtest pair and SceneSpec read landmarks[0]
landmarks_append.band_names: the plate's: upper (3,200-4,000 m) and mid (2,400-3,200 m). The schema's band enum has mid but no upper; add 'upper' to viewpoints/schema/viewpoint.schema.json in the same commit, or these entries do not validate
landmarks_append.same_commit: workers/forecast/tests/test_points.py::test_rainier_points: the landmark count goes from 1 to 4, and Rainier's forecast files gain three landmark points from the next snapshot

camera.keep: view_azimuth_deg stays the bearing to the summit (its view_azimuth_source): the forecast worker lays its view-ray sample points along it (workers/forecast/src/snow_globe_forecast/points.py), and the solved optical heading belongs in pose.heading_deg

if_the_solved_position_is_adopted.elevation_note: USGS 3DEP ground under the solved position; the plate assumes the lens 10 m above it (1697.95 m); the mount is unidentified
if_the_solved_position_is_adopted.view_azimuth_source: computed: initial great-circle bearing from the plate v0.1 camera position to the GNIS Mount Rainier summit point
if_the_solved_position_is_adopted.position_uncertainty_basis: the solve moves 60 m north between an assumed lens height of 3 m and 40 m (plate.json pose_check.agl_sensitivity), and the near ridge 1.8-3.3 km out fits only from a position about 170 m further south (plates/README.md, 'Near field'), which the stars and far landmarks reject; 200 m covers both
if_the_solved_position_is_adopted.every_landmark: distance_km and azimuth_deg must be recomputed with the camera (the loader checks bearings to 0.5 deg): the summit becomes 7.44 km at 346.2 deg

pose.pose_check_method: gnis-landmarks+stars: landmark reprojection is a fit residual (the camera position is fitted to the three landmarks); the independent check is the DEM skyline per band (summit p90 0.41 deg, upper 0.37, mid 0.16; near 1.22, over its 1 deg bar)
pose.note: fov_deg is the horizontal FOV, the renderer's hfov; pose_rms_px is the stars' median residual

plate.version_note: the schema wants an integer: plate v0.1 would be version 1 here unless the schema takes the builder's plate_version string

dem.source: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM, 10 m, via the National Map 3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage (23 Nov 2026)
